key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (BRIVIACT N=803 vs placebo N=459) were somnolence and sedation (16% vs 8%), dizziness (12% vs 7%), fatigue (9% vs 4%), and nausea/vomiting (5% vs 3%). Warnings include suicidal behavior/ideation, neurological adverse reactions (somnolence, fatigue, dizziness, and gait disturbance), psychiatric adverse reactions, and hypersensitivity (bronchospasm and angioedema).
